title: Connection failures on api-gateway
impact: Requests failed while connections were refused on api-gateway
symptom: [ANOMALY] api-gateway 2026-03-16 08:38-11:58: api-gateway: 168 of 240 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-03-16 08:38 and 2026-03-16 11:58 UTC (peak error ratio 0.88 vs baseline median 0.0). 4 error templates, 2 first seen in this span. Peak p95 latency 0.605 s vs baseline band up to 0.245 s.
error_templates: health check took <*> s (target group timeout 2 s)

_templates.macro: Terraform change cut the {svc} target-group health-check timeout {old} -> {new} s; targets under load flapped unhealthy and the ALB returned 502.

rca.macro: Terraform change cut the api-gateway target-group health-check timeout 5 -> 2 s; targets under load flapped unhealthy and the ALB returned 502.
rca.micro: infra/api-gateway.tf:101 sets health_check timeout 5 -> 2 on aws_lb_target_group.api_gateway.
rca.remediation: Restore the health-check timeout = 5 on aws_lb_target_group.api_gateway.

action_items: Require a reviewed `terraform plan` and a CloudWatch alarm for the changed AWS resource.
Alert on the error signature `received SIGTERM, draining connections (target deregistered)`.
